description: Module B reverification: functional verification battery found and fixed four bugs in the credit engine and stress stack.
bugs_found_and_fixed: Transition matrix rows did not sum to 1.0 (AAA 0.993) - Markov powers drifted; rows now normalized

Migration widening was inactive: integer-notch rounding turned every expected downgrade into 0bps; replaced with fractional interpolation between rating-spread rows (BB now widens 13bps, B 34bps from expected migration alone)
Reverse stress lower bound (0.5x) missed the true COVID breach boundary (~0.25x); floor moved to 0.0 - corrected boundary 0.25x, CET1 7.0% at breach

Swap DV01s were ~10x understated in portfolio.json (e.g. $400M 5Y swap: $19k/bp vs correct ~$184k/bp); recomputed as notional x duration x 0.0001 - hedges now realistic (COVID derivative P&L: -69.2M with proper hedges)
verified_clean: sovereign bond repricing matches duration+convexity exactly
